services.desc: Enjoy a Fireworks Cruise every 3rd Friday in August! In celebration of Grand Illumination, enjoy the fireworks show on a private cruise. Details: It is a fireworks extravaganza! The Oak Bluffs Fire Department does a bang-up job every year and this event should not be missed. Depart Falmouth Harbor with your family, friends, food and drink for a memorable evening watching the fireworks from the classic luxury passenger vessel, Plan Sea.
